items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I got to play with, you know, the Temptations and the Four Tops, and Martha Reeves, and the OJ’s, and groups like that.

ctx.x: Do you augment these kind of gigs with anything like pit bands or playing theater shows, that kind of thing?

Not so much theater and pit bands. I do live in New York so you’d think maybe I was doing Broadway. But that’s kind of a very specific kind of playing that I’m not as interested in and not really as cut out for that, although I read and everything, that’s not the problem, it’s just that I don’t think I would enjoy it mostly. But I have always done different kinds of gigs and I’ll do private parties, which could mean weddings or anniversary parties, or things like that, dances, or oh, any number of things, all…
Looks good on your resume, too, huh? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
